title: fix(studio): the OWD overview's Save publishes each object pinned to the published row its load read
body:
Fixes #36962
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:Studio 的「记录共享基线」总览页里,两位管理员同时改同一个对象的共享默认值时,后保存的那位不再悄悄覆盖前一位,而是弹出冲突对话框(重新加载 / 确认覆盖 / 继续编辑);同一次保存里的其他对象各自照样核对,别人也改过的同样会问。
- 为什么做:Studio 各编辑器已经按「加载时读到的已发布版本」防止互相覆盖,唯独这张总览页的保存被漏掉了;共享默认值关系到谁能看到哪些记录。
- 出错会怎样:若判断有误,管理员可能在无人并发时也看到冲突对话框,选「重新加载」或「确认覆盖」即可继续;本改动只在前端,可直接回退,不改数据。
- 要你做什么:无

## What changes

`PackageOwdOverviewPanel.tsx` (the Studio OWD overview, one Save for every changed object):

- The load records, per row, the published row it read (`publishedPinOfLayers` over the row's layers read, at the package the publish writes) into a `useDraftSaveGuard` held by the panel (`recordPublished`).
- A row the package's published list does not hold, whose layers are not asked while its draft is in hand, is pinned `If-None-Match: *` (no published row of its name). A saved row whose layers read failed pins nothing.
- The Save's per-row publish now passes the guard's pinned publish to `publishSavedItem` (its existing fourth parameter; `studioSaveBar.tsx` untouched). A publish over a row another writer published since is refused `409 METADATA_CONFLICT` and the existing conflict dialog asks: reload, overwrite after a confirmation, or keep editing.
- The panel keeps its own record of the pin each row's edit was made on, and sends that row's pin to the guard again immediately before the row's publish. A conflict answered "reload" clears every pin the guard holds, for every row; without the re-send the rows after it in the same pass, and a confirm of the controlled-by-parent prerequisite after a re-read that failed, would publish unpinned.
- Partial save (objectstack#36511) is kept: a refused row is named and keeps its edit; the other rows carry on, each still published over the row its own load read, whatever an earlier row was answered, so another row a second admin changed is asked about too.
- A row answered "reload" is read back once the pass ends, and the Save reads as declined. The draft the Save wrote is taken back first, unless a draft was pending before the Save (a copilot's): that draft is kept, now carrying the edit, and is shown as the row's value under the unpublished-draft mark while the live row is the other admin's; its next Save stays pinned to the version the conflict was raised on and is asked again (the guard's rule 9).
- The table re-read after a partial save keeps each unsaved row pinned to the read its edit was made on (never the fresh read), so the next Save over a row that moved is asked again instead of slipping through.
- The guard's own reload callback is a no-op: the Save that met the conflict re-reads the table itself once its pass ends, keeping the edits of the rows it did not save.

One changeset (`@object-ui/app-shell` patch).

## Tests

New `PackageOwdOverviewPanel.publishPinned-36962.test.tsx`, against a server double whose publish door honours `If-Match` / `If-None-Match` and answers its 409 through the real `MetadataClient` error parser:

- race: another admin publishes between load and Save, the Save is refused at its publish and the live-change conflict dialog opens; keep editing leaves the edit unsaved and takes the written draft back;
- reload: the other admin's value is read back and the next Save is pinned to it;
- overwrite: asked twice, then re-published pinned to the refusal's `currentVersion`;
- two rows, one raced: the other goes live pinned to its own read; the kept edit stays pinned to its original read, so the next Save is asked again;
- one editor: consecutive Saves pinned to the version the last one left, no self-conflict;
- a draft-only row publishes `If-None-Match: *`;
- control: a server that serves no `overlayVersion` gets an unpinned publish, as before;
- reload in a pass of several rows: both rows raced, reload on the first, and the second is still refused and asked, its publish carrying its own load's `If-Match`;
- the first row refused and kept, the second reloaded: the kept edit's next Save is still pinned to its own load and asked;
- a row with a draft pending before the Save, raced, reload: the draft is kept carrying the edit, shown under the unpublished-draft mark, and the next Save is asked again, pinned to the version the conflict was raised on;
- control: a draft-only row whose name another writer published since is refused on `If-None-Match: *`, not published over.

Ablation 1 (drop the pin from the publish call): 10 of 11 red, the unpinned control green. Ablation 2 (never keep a kept edit's original pin across the re-read): exactly the two kept-edit cases red. Ablation 3 (drop the re-send before each publish): exactly the reload-on-the-first-row case red. All restored, blob equals HEAD.

## Acceptance notes

- The overview's draft save still goes through `client.save` unguarded (no draft pin). It is a whole-document write over a read made a moment earlier, so a draft another writer wrote in between is replaced; and `hasDraft` is the load's reading, not the Save's. A concurrent change to the live `sharingModel` is still caught at the publish this PR pins. Both, with the panel's pin-record housekeeping, are carried by #37515.
- A Save in which the author chose "reload" for one row reports `declined` to the top bar even when other rows went live in the same pass (no "saved" toast); the rows that went live read back as saved on the page. Same answer the object page gives for a reloaded Save.
